milestones.outcome: Home separates my actionable, quiet and unknown pull requests from Needs me while keeping waiting-only rows in Waiting on others, with preserved activity, view persistence and exact navigation.
exit_criteria: AC01–AC02: deterministic exact-row ownership and section placement preserve attention, notifications and repository counts.
AC03: the rendered Home behaves correctly in every Group and State headers setting, filtering, collapse and keyboard navigation.
AC04: upgrade and a two-window process restart retain independent collapse and unchanged view choices.
AC05: accepted composed refresh and ordinary Open retain exact identity and destination without extra provider work.
Focused public-path, core-only, architecture, format and documentation gates pass; live contracts and closeout record the actual candidate and any pending evidence.
milestones.boundary: One complete Home behavior milestone, with all five RFC acceptance criteria and truthful final upkeep.
